hooks.description: Injects a delegation directive when a prompt looks multi-part (heuristic, ~1ms).
Prints the context-window meter notice from heimdall-ctx-meter.
REFUSES a prompt carrying a pasted credential so the value is never transmitted (heimdall-secret-filter).
Adds the current caveman compression level as additionalContext on every prompt.
git-guard stale-lock clear, commit secret scan, pre-push quality/secret/selfscan/oracle/corpus gates (exit 2 blocks).
Counts Read/Grep/Glob calls for the parallelism grade.
Named-agent notice and the brief-adoption gate that rewrites oversized spawn prompts (heimdall-precheck-agent).
BIFROST stub gate: blocks Write/Edit content matching an unfinished-code shape (exit 2).
Advisory collision pre-warning when a live teammate holds a claim on the file (heimdall-precheck-edit).
BLOCKS Read/Grep/Glob/Bash reads of credential-bearing files before they enter model context.
Captures a failed oracle report into the regression corpus after a Bash call.
Logs every edit, marks heimdall-state dirty (arms the pre-push quality gate), autocommits at 5+ changed files.
Background, throttled heimdall-context-sync after a Write/Edit.
Writes a journal entry when a Bash call landed a new git commit.
Autoupdate check, statusline register, selfheal, tracker builds, state init, stack detect, team/presence beat, reap/cleanup advice, checkpoint notice.
Runs heimdall-resume-probe (10s alarm) when a CHECKPOINT.md exists and prints its head.
heimdall-maintain-loop resume-hint.
heimdall-quota-resume resume-hint.
heimdall-dream-notice for the repo.
Starts the presence keeper for this session in the background (paired with presence-keeper-stop).
heimdall-presence connect-prompt.
heimdall-ai-select session-start.
Restarts a claude-mem daemon that is running with a routing/fallback-credential-contaminated env (credential egress fix C-1).
Prints the caveman compression rules into session context.
Advisory: warns about ANTHROPIC_* overrides persisted in a Claude Code settings.json env block (5s alarm).
Advisory: warns when the clone sits on volatile disk holding unpushed work (5s alarm).
Records a heimdall-metric task outcome for the finished subagent.
Scans the subagent transcript for a 429/rate-limit and marks it for fallback routing.
Metric reminder at main-agent Stop.
Detects a stale present-tense process-status claim in the final message (heimdall-claim-check).
Scans the main transcript for a 429/rate-limit and marks it for fallback routing.
Stops this session's presence keeper (disabling it with presence-keeper-start enabled leaks a keeper process).
Background: checkpoint write, parallelism grade, verify-edits --quick, autocommit, cleanup, reel, summary-card, context-sync; then the farewell.
